description: Install npm dependencies and verify baseline build compiles successfully before making changes.
steps: Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compilation succeeds with zero errors
If build errors occur, fix any missing type issues or configuration problems
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with exit code 0
findings: Node.js not pre-installed; used mise to install node@22 with MISE_NODE_VERIFY=false (gpg-agent not available). Fixed multiple TS build errors: tsconfig.node.json needed composite+emitDeclarationOnly for project references, added @types/node for vite.config.ts, created src/vite-env.d.ts for import.meta.env, added index signature to ListParams interface, fixed noUncheckedIndexedAccess issues in AgentAvatar, removed unreachable comparison in useOffice, removed unused import in Memory.tsx.
